kill_criteria.observed: not re-measured live in this run; covered by the relay/client verify suite (make relay-test / client rules tests: forged, under-signed, rolled-back and expired bundles rejected). The t0 smoke verified a valid bundle requires >=3 distinct operators.

t0 smoke: a co-signed emergency stop (scope all) was effective and applied on the client ~0.1 s after it took effect (polling resolution ~0.25 s), far under the 60 s kill criterion. Not a B10 fan-out measurement.

notes: M7 from the relay/distribution side. Emergency-stop propagation measured by the t0 smoke (~0.1 s, polling resolution; not the B10 fan-out benchmark).
